recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the removed Observation.code SCT attribute mapping unless OO revisits FHIR-29775; broader semantic-model binding work should proceed through a new explicit OO decision.
issue_request: FHIR-12239 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request asking HL7 to review IHTSDO recommendations for using SNOMED CT in Observation and apply the individual value-set/binding dispositions from the attached document.
initial_application: Historical commit 8f5579319910f584e8044f2fa17414395ab9f346, with subject [#12239], applied the issue by adding Observation SNOMED CT concept-domain and attribute mapping information in the old spreadsheet source and revising Observation Methods to include SNOMED CT technique, action, and evaluation-procedure descendants.
additional_context: The Observation spreadsheet source was later refactored into source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml and supporting value-set XML. Later Applied issue FHIR-29775 intentionally removed only the Observation.code SCT attribute Is-a mapping, while related no-change issue FHIR-31383 declined broader core semantic-model bindings. No direct Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current-build Observation StructureDefinition retains the relevant SNOMED CT mapping spaces, concept-domain mappings, and remaining attribute mappings, and Observation Methods still uses the SNOMED CT descendants added by the historical application.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue intentionally removed the Observation.code SNOMED CT Attribute Binding of 116680003 |Is a|; the combined branch already contains an audit commit for it.
Later Resolved - No Change issue declined broader core semantic-model bindings for Observation, supporting no expansion beyond existing FHIR-12239 mappings.
Later Resolved - No Change issue concerned validator vital-sign SCT mappings rather than core specification source changes.
